public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic is just as unprofitable as OpenAI and has made hundreds of billions of dollars' worth of promises it also can't keep.

statement.excerpt: It won’t matter that Anthropic is just as unprofitable or made hundreds of billions of dollars’ worth of promises it also can’t keep.

from_speaker: hundreds of billions of dollars’ worth of promises
our_interpretation: Read 'just as unprofitable' as similarly loss-making, without requiring identical dollar losses. A fair comparison still requires consistent profit measures.
Read 'hundreds of billions' as at least $200 billion of existing compute commitments, rather than investment announcements or optional capacity.
Read 'can't keep' as an assertion of financial inability, not merely exposure to substantial risk.

Use calendar Q2 2026, the latest completed quarter before the post, for the ongoing financial observation and its quarter-end commitments snapshot. Whether commitments changed between June 30 and August 18 remains a separate limitation.

The single metric_scope records the quantified commitments component. The profitability component additionally requires comparable losses for Anthropic and OpenAI; the source does not identify their accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable financial results establish that Anthropic is similarly loss-making, existing commitments reach at least $200 billion, and dated evidence establishes inability to meet those commitments after allowing for funding and their payment schedules.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched evidence establishes profitability inconsistent with the comparison, commitments below the stated scale, or demonstrable ability to fulfill the identified commitments. A positive operating result alone does not negate a net loss.

evidence.locator: Risk Factors, page 64; Quarterly Consolidated Statements of Operations; purchase commitments note, F-59
evidence.explanation: The filing reports $265.6 billion of fixed or minimum purchase commitments at June 30; its Q2 tables show a $66.309 billion net loss alongside $974 million operating income. These establish substantial obligations and conflicting signals across profit measures, but not a matched OpenAI comparison or inability to pay.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A clearly scoped comparison of both companies' financial results, identified commitments and payment dates, and evidence establishing whether Anthropic can meet those obligations with available and obtainable funding.
